definitions.explanation: The everyday short form of {文部科学省|もんぶかがくしょう}, the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology. It sets the national curriculum, approves school textbooks, and funds universities and research.

examples.japanese: {文科省|もんかしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Education announced its policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文科省|もんかしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検定|けんてい}→検定：13131_kentei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Textbooks are screened by the Ministry of Education.

examples.japanese: {文科省|もんかしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The Ministry of Education plans to increase elementary-school class hours from next year.

notes:
News headlines and speech use {文科省|もんかしょう}; documents and formal announcements use the full name ⟦{文部科学省|もんぶかがくしょう}→文部科学省：31175_monbukagakushou⟧. Before the 2001 reorganization the ministry was {文部省|もんぶしょう}, a name still met in older writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文科省|もんかしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: a Ministry of Education survey
- {文科省|もんかしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: a ministry notice to schools
- {文科相|もんかしょう}: the education minister (news short form, read the same way); formally {文部科学大臣|もんぶかがくだいじん}
- ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}{指導|しどう}{要領|ようりょう}→学習指導要領：26215_gakushuushidouyouryou⟧: the national curriculum guidelines the ministry issues
